apps.name: Windwatch
apps.description: Standalone wind monitor with chart-matched wind colors and the original interactive Stageline chart. Applicable procedures stay in color; other sections are grey and tap to enlarge. Swipeable Wind, Procedures, On-site, Forecast and Setup pages. Checks wind every minute while open. Procedures and manual readings work offline; fresh weather and search need internet. Professional weather use needs an appropriate Open-Meteo plan.
